subject: Interactive chloropleth with custom geoJSON layer using Shiny and Leaflet

messages.author: 795f4c4a08018366
messages.subject: Interactive chloropleth with custom geoJSON layer using Shiny and Leaflet
parts:
Hello all,

I am trying to create a Shiny application with an embedded Leaflet map overlayed with a chloropleth and optionally Multipoints with a custom icon and pop-up that only shows up when clicked or hovered.  

Many thanks in advance to those who can take the time to help!
Jane

Chloropleth question
I am new to Leaflet.js and am having trouble integrating the Leaflet-specific tutorial here (http://leafletjs.com/examples/choropleth.html) with R syntax.

I have a working version of the Leaflet with the chloropleth, but have not been able to successful implement the interactive component. 

>>> What wrappers are necessary to translate the Leaflet.js into R syntax?

Custm GeoJSON layer question
Reproducible example below. Custom icons are working with addMarkers and addPopups, but I do not want the pop-ups to start open. When I try to do a custom GeoJSON layer, however, neither the pop-up nor the custom icon is showing. 

>>> Is there a way to either make the addPopups visible only upon click or upon hover? 

>>> If not, any pointers on how to get the custom GeoJSON layer to work would be much appreciated!

library(leaflet)
library(shiny)

# define dummy data
test <- data.frame(long = c(34.2, 34.7, 35, 34.8, 34.6), 
    lat = c(0.451, -0.715, 0.778, -0.771, -0.594), 
    name = c("Site1", "Site2", "Site3", "Site4", "Site5"))

shinyApp(
    ui = fluidPage(
        leafletOutput("map.json"),
        br(),
        leafletOutput("map.markers")
  ),
  server = function(input, output, session) {
    
    # define GeoJSON layer
    sites <- list(
        type = "Feature",
        properties = list(
           popup = test$name,
           iconUrl = 'leaf-black.png',
           iconSize = c(15, 15)),
      geometry = list(
           type = 'MultiPoint',
           coordinates = cbind(test$long, test$lat))
      )
    
    # addGeoJSON vector pop-up and custom icon not working
    output$map.json <- renderLeaflet({
        leaflet() %>% addTiles() %>% 
            fitBounds(lng1 = 34, lat1 = -0.7, lng2 = 35.1, lat2 = 1) %>%
            addGeoJSON(sites)
    })
    
    # addMarkers custom icon works with addPopups, but popups are automatically up
    output$map.markers <- renderLeaflet({
        leaflet(data = test) %>% addTiles() %>% 
            fitBounds(lng1 = 34, lat1 = -0.7, lng2 = 35.1, lat2 = 1) %>%
            addMarkers(lng = ~long, lat = ~lat,
                icon = JS("L.icon({
                    iconUrl: 'http://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/a6/One_Acre_Fund_leaf.jpg',
                    iconSize: [15, 15]})")) %>%
            addPopups(lng = ~long, lat = ~lat, popup = test$name)
    })
  }
)
